title: [BUG] Unable to detect sub agent
body: ## Environment - Claude CLI version: 1.0.61 - Operating System: macOS Ventura 13.2.1 - Terminal: iterm2 zsh ## Bug Description ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Added an agent via /agents 2. /agents⎿ Agent changes: Created agent: code-reviewer 3. There are normal new files in .claude/agents in the project root directory 4. /agents -> No agents found Already tried restarting & uninstall claude code
